results.content:
⭐ 1/5 — Extremely frustrating P2P dispute handling and unfair burden on the seller  
I have been a KuCoin P2P seller, and my recent experience with KuCoin’s dispute process was extremely stressful and disappointing.  
On September 4, 2026, I had two separate P2P orders with the same buyer, each for CAD 200.  
For the first order (Order ID: 6a9b3cbfa7490200019aed6d), the buyer actually sent me CAD 200. The payment had a unique bank reference number: C1AVuP5f48Fg. I received the payment and released the USDT, and the order was successfully completed.  
Approximately two hours later, the same buyer had another CAD 200 order (Order ID: 6a9b4df3ad751300017b2fe8).  
The problem was that I did NOT receive a second CAD 200 payment. [...] Why is a seller being forced to jump through ridiculous hoops to prove a negative when the buyer hasn't provided a single shred of payment proof and has already agreed to cancel? The customer service agents do not apply common sense and ignore the evidence directly in front of them.  
If you are a P2P merchant or a regular user, stay far away from this app. They will freeze your assets over easily verifiable misunderstandings, fail to hold non-paying buyers accountable, and demand completely irrelevant documents. Incredibly frustrating and unprofessional experience. [...] Formal Public Complaint Against KuCoin – Request for Return of My 202 USDT  
Dear KuCoin Management, Customer Support Team, and Community,  
I am writing this public complaint to seek assistance regarding my pending 202 USDT deposit, which I transferred from my MEXC account to KuCoin using the BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) network.  
Unfortunately, despite repeated communication with KuCoin customer support, my funds have still not been credited to my account or returned to the original sending address.  
Background of My Case  
\- Exchange: MEXC to KuCoin  
\- Amount: 202 USDT  
\- Network: BEP20 (BNB Smart Chain)  
\- Transaction: Successful on the blockchain  
\- Issue: Deposit pending investigation and resolution.
